briefing: Markets edged higher today with NASDAQ and S&P500 both up 0.6%, a mild but genuine risk-on signal. With 3 open slots and cash above the deployment threshold, I bought HIMS and DOCN, the two top-scored candidates with full multi-signal confirmation (bullish MACD crossover, healthy RSI, price above SMA-20, and volume surge), leaving one slot open and keeping existing winners untouched.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum investing means buying stocks that are already trending upward, based on the idea that strong price moves tend to continue in the short term. Today's buys were chosen because multiple technical signals lined up together — rising price, healthy RSI, a bullish MACD crossover, and surging volume — which together suggest real buying interest rather than a random blip.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能投資是指買入股價已經呈現上升趨勢的股票,原理是強勢的價格走勢在短期內往往會持續。今日的買入決定是因為多項技術訊號同時出現——股價上升、RSI健康、MACD出現黃金交叉,以及成交量放大——這些訊號together顯示真正的買盤興趣,而非偶然波動。

market_education.summary_en: Broad indices posted modest gains today, with the NASDAQ and S&P 500 each up about 0.6%, reflecting steady risk appetite rather than a sharp rally. The gains were broad-based across growth and healthcare-adjacent names rather than driven by a single catalyst. Momentum names with confirmed technical signals, like HIMS and DOCN, continued to attract buying interest as volume surges suggested institutional participation.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市溫和上揚,納指及標普500指數分別上升約0.6%,顯示市場風險偏好穩定,而非出現急升行情。升勢屬於較廣泛性,並非單一消息帶動,增長股及醫療相關股份均有參與。部分具明確技術訊號的動能股,例如HIMS及DOCN,受到成交量放大帶動,反映機構投資者持續入市。

trades.reasoning: Perfect multi-signal confirmation (RSI 67.5 in bullish zone, MACD bullish crossover with rising histogram, price above SMA-20, volume surge) on a risk-on day with an open slot and cash above the $500 threshold.
Same four-signal confirmation (RSI 58.7, MACD bullish crossover, price above SMA-20, volume surge) gives institutional-grade conviction to deploy more idle cash.
